warden.name: Celestial Glaives
warden.desc: Level 30 PassiveYour Scattered Stars can now stack 2 additional times.

warden.name: Astral Blade
warden.desc: Drains 25% Maximum ManaStrike an enemy with precision, dealing AP Arcane damage, increased further based on your maximum mana.Increases your dealt to the enemy by 15% for 5 seconds.

warden.name: Moonstone
warden.desc: Increases the damage of Lunar Lance by 20%.

warden.name: Moonlit Impaler
warden.desc: Increases your Arcane damage by 5% and your hit chance by 2%. (up to 2 ranks)

warden.name: Stellar Amplification
warden.desc: Dealing damage with Scattered Stars now has a 15% chance to make your next Astral Blade free of cost.

warden.name: Vigil of the Watchers
warden.desc: Increases critical strike chance of all party and raid members by 3%.Does not stack with similar effects.

warden.name: Rally The Sentinels
warden.desc: Sentinel Glaive now restores 20% of your maximum mana and applies a Scattered Star to the enemy.

warden.name: Wrath of Elune
warden.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Sentinel Glaive by -5 sec.

warden.name: Star Pupil
warden.desc: Your damaging critical strikes now grant you a stack of Star Pupil.Star PupilReduces the cast time of Moonwell Splash by -25% for 8 seconds, stacking 4 times.While this is active, Moonwell Splash is castable while moving.

warden.name: Bonds of Justice
warden.desc: Send forth bonds of justice to an enemy, tethering them to you for 8 seconds. the tether is broken through expiration or the target runs at least 10 yds from you, they are gripped back towards you, taking arcane SP Arcane damage.

warden.name: Astral Combatant
warden.desc: Lunar Lance and Umbral Blade increase the enemy damage taken from Scattered Stars by 10% for 10 seconds.

warden.name: Maiev's Guard
warden.desc: Critical strikes with Astral Blade now strike 2 additional times, one for 40% of the damage dealt and the other for 20% of the damage dealt.

warden.name: Astral Onslaught
warden.desc: Increases the duration of Astral Blade by 7 sec.

warden.name: Astral Finesse
warden.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Astral Blade by -4 sec.
